gimmicks.name: Back doors swing open
gimmicks.description: Ambulance doors fly open on bumps; unsecured items slide onto the road

gimmicks.name: Basement flood
gimmicks.description: Water rises on the lower floor; stations there go offline one by one

gimmicks.name: Deck tilt and pool slosh
gimmicks.description: The ship tilts on a rhythm; big tilts send pool water across the deck

gimmicks.name: Earthquake islands
gimmicks.description: Cracks split the site into islands; plank bridges come and go

gimmicks.name: Elevator lab
gimmicks.description: The lab lives inside the elevator and moves between floors

gimmicks.name: Fire drill
gimmicks.description: Sprinklers soak one wing; patients get wheeled to the other side

gimmicks.name: Layout flip
gimmicks.description: At the halfway mark the map mirrors

gimmicks.name: Lights roulette
gimmicks.description: Lights go out room by room in sequence

gimmicks.name: Moving walkway
gimmicks.description: Hallway conveyor carries players and dropped items; fast one way, slow against it

gimmicks.name: Pod shuffle
gimmicks.description: ICU rooms are modular pods that slide to new spots mid-level

gimmicks.name: Revolving door
gimmicks.description: The main entrance spins, carrying players and wheelchairs around

gimmicks.name: Robot mop
gimmicks.description: A cleaning robot roams, leaving slippery trails and bumping carts

gimmicks.name: Rolling beds
gimmicks.description: Unlocked beds drift down a sloped floor until someone locks them

gimmicks.name: Sky bridge
gimmicks.description: Two wings connected by a bridge that retracts and extends

gimmicks.name: Spinning station
gimmicks.description: A desk or station on a turntable rotates every so often

gimmicks.name: Stampede lane
gimmicks.description: Runners, traffic, or crowds sweep across a lane, knocking items out of hands

gimmicks.name: Swinging doors
gimmicks.description: Doors fly open when stretchers rush through and bonk anyone nearby

gimmicks.name: Tent takeoff
gimmicks.description: Wind lifts part of the tent; stations land somewhere new

gimmicks.name: Tube mixup
gimmicks.description: The pneumatic tube sometimes delivers samples to the wrong station

gimmicks.name: Under construction
gimmicks.description: Missing floor sections; a crane swings supplies across the map
